name: Gaussian Rasterization Wrapper
definition: A wrapper function that prepares Gaussian splat parameters and calls the underlying rasterization kernel, handling appearance, masks, and camera models.
summary: The Gaussian Rasterization Wrapper is a high-level Python function that orchestrates 3D Gaussian splatting by preparing parameters and invoking the rasterization kernel, distinguished by its unified interface for appearance optimization, packed memory layouts, and sparse gradient computation.
